errors.evidence: The description omits that the unemployment rate is for the specific age group of 15-64, which is explicitly mentioned in the chart's title: "Коефициент на безработица (15-64 г., %)".
The value for the "общо за страната" series in 2016 is closer to 8%, not 7% as stated.
The value for the "Северозападен район" series in 2016 is approximately 11%, not 10%.
The value for the "област Враца" series in 2016 is approximately 14%, not 13%.
The value for the "област Ловеч" series in 2016 is approximately 7.5%, but the value for 2018 is closer to 10%, not mentioned in the description.
The value for the "област Плевен" series in 2016 is closer to 10.5%, not 11%.
The value for the "област Плевен" series in 2019 is closer to 8%, not 6%.
